items.title: Scope down permissions of existing sessions using AWS STS GetScopedCredentials
items.summary: When you build AI agents, you often want each agent or sub-agent to have only the permissions its tasks require, rather than the full permissions of the session that started it. GetScopedCredentials is a new AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) API that you can use to scope down the permissions of existing temporary security […]
